notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Hypervolt Grasp by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Hypervolt Grasp spell.
Activate Hypervolt Grasp by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
